findings.title: A single combining U+0345 (COMBINING GREEK YPOGEGRAMMENI) is turned into the letter 'i' by the new case fold, so 'Dr. Claire Moreau' + U+0345 is a different key: a visually near-identical teacher twin, including of the RESERVED demo teacher name, is accepted
findings.evidence: U+0345 is a Mn mark with an Other_Lowercase uppercase mapping: '\u0345'.toUpperCase() === 'Ι'. foldCase = toLowerCase().toUpperCase().toLowerCase() now runs BEFORE the accent/mark stripping, so the mark becomes a real letter 'ι' (mapped to 'i' by LOWER) instead of being dropped like every other combining mark. Brute force over all 1 114 112 code points: of all \p{M} characters only U+0345 changes nameKey('Maria Lopez') (names4.ts). Live on 5601: POST /api/auth/register {name:'Dr. Claire Moreau\u0345', teacherInviteCode} -> 201, user.name 'Dr. Claire Moreauͅ' (the demo name is reserved and 'DR CLAIRE MOREAU' / 'Dr. C1aire M0reau' are 409). Same for any colleague: 'Zed Quark..' + U+0345 -> 201 while the upper-case variant is 409. Class names have the same hole (POST /api/classes 'Bio' then 'Bio\u0345' -> 201 and 201). The same mark placed after a space/digit/emoji (stray-mark rule) also becomes a letter. Round 12 stripped it like any accent, so this is a regression of the round-13 fix.
findings.repro: scratchpad/r14-A/t_u345.mjs (BASE=http://127.0.0.1:5601 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning t_u345.mjs); key level: scratchpad/r14-A/names4.ts; class level: scratchpad/r14-A/class1.mjs (last pair).
findings.expected: A combining mark (any) after a letter is an accent and is dropped, so nameKey('X') === nameKey('X\u0345') and the register/rename answers 409 name_taken (and the reserved demo name stays reserved).
findings.actual: 201 Created; two teachers (or a teacher and the seeded demo teacher) can hold names that differ only by a tiny iota under one letter. Reviewer labels stay unambiguous only through '(teacher #id)'.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/names.ts prepare(): strip \p{M} that follow letters BEFORE foldCase (or replace U+0345 with '' right after the first NFKC, before foldCase); keep the polytonic precomposed letters (ᾳ -> αι) working through the existing case fold. Apply the same to classNameKey (names.ts classNameKey) and to the assistant guard (see R14-A-04, same root cause). Add U+0345 to the all-code-points test.

findings.title: A database file without owner write permission (chmod 444/400, already in WAL mode) starts normally and prints 'listening', but EVERY write route answers 500 internal_error; with mode 0400 there is no message at all, and the 0444 warning itself advises 'consider chmod 400'
findings.evidence: Created a v7 WAL database, chmod 444 on db/-wal/-shm, started src/server.ts: log 'Escape Lab: ...ro.db is read-only (mode 0444) and readable by others; leaving it as it is ... consider chmod 400.' then 'listening'. GET /api/me, /dashboard, /labs, /badges, /profile, /leaderboard -> 200 (reads work) but POST /api/auth/register -> 500 and POST /api/missions/hem-03/start -> 500 (stack 'attempt to write a readonly database' in the log). Re-run after chmod 400 (the advised mode): server prints nothing but 'listening', POST /missions/{id}/start -> 500 x3. A student can log in and read, then every answer/start fails. This contradicts the round-12 rule that a DB_PATH that is 'unwritable' ends start-up with one explicit line (an old-schema read-only file does, 'attempt to write a readonly database'); only a v7 file in WAL mode slips through because no write happens at start-up.
findings.repro: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH; S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-A; cp a seeded DB to $S/dbt/ro.db, open it once with $S/opendb.ts (WAL), chmod 444 (or 400) ro.db ro.db-wal ro.db-shm, then cd be && AUTH_SECRET=<32 chars> DEMO_MODE=1 PORT=5611 DB_PATH=$S/dbt/ro.db node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts; POST /api/auth/demo {role:student} then POST /api/missions/hem-03/start -> 500. Log: scratchpad/r14-A/s5611.log
findings.expected: Refuse to start (one line, exit 1) or at least log 'database is not writable: sign-up, missions and progress will fail' for every read-only mode, not only when others can read it; never recommend a mode that leaves the service half dead.
findings.actual: Service reports healthy (GET /api/health 200) while all writes 500; no warning at 0400.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/db.ts restrictFiles/openDb: after opening, run a trivial write probe (BEGIN IMMEDIATE; ROLLBACK) or accessSync(path, W_OK) and throw 'database is not writable' (reuse the server.ts fatal path); drop 'consider chmod 400' from the warning or add 'the API cannot write to it'.

findings.title: The guard only knows the option LABEL and 'the answer/option/choice is'; it does not know the option LETTER the provider is shown ('C. Iron deficiency anemia'), so 'Option C', 'C is correct', 'Choose C', 'Go with C', 'Answer: C', 'It is C', 'Option C is the best fit' all reach the learner
findings.evidence: Game.cleanAssistantHint(text, hem-03-s2) (correct option id C, ids are single letters A-D on every choice step, see keyorder.ts): ALLOW for 'C is correct.', 'Choose C.', 'Pick option C.', 'Go with C', 'I would select (C).', 'Answer: C', 'It is C', 'The right one is C', 'Option C is the best fit', 'Everything except A, B and D is wrong'. Only 'The correct choice is C' / 'the answer is C' are rejected, by the phrase regex. The Anthropic request lists every option as `${o.id}. ${o.label}` and the system prompt merely asks the model not to give a letter, so the realistic way a model leaks is by letter, not by repeating the label. Documented limitation says 'filters only answers that appear verbatim'; a letter is not verbatim-label, and no document says ids are unguarded.
findings.repro: scratchpad/r14-A/leak3.ts (node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning leak3.ts); phrasing battery in leak1.ts.
findings.expected: For choice/decision steps a hint that names the correct option id (as a standalone token / after option|choice|answer|pick|choose|select|go with) is dropped like a label leak and the faculty hint is delivered instead.
findings.actual: Letter-based leak delivered as a paid 'assistant' hint (source 'assistant', -15 XP, stored in hint_log.text and replayed in hintsGiven).
findings.fix_hint: be/src/assistant.ts leaksAnswer: for k.kind choice/decision also test the id with word boundaries, e.g. new RegExp(`(^|[^\\p{L}\\p{N}])${escape(id)}([^\\p{L}\\p{N}]|$)`,'iu') combined with a trigger word list, or simply reject any standalone single-letter id token when ids are single letters; also allow 'option|choice ... is' with an optional letter between (current regex needs 'option is').

findings.title: Guard still passes a correct label written with digits/ASCII look-alikes (leetspeak), reversed, with IPA/small-cap/Armenian/Cherokee homoglyphs, or with an inserted U+0345
findings.evidence: cleanAssistantHint on 'Iron deficiency anemia' written as: '1ron deficiency anemia', 'lron deficiency anemia', 'Ir0n deficiency anemia', 'Iron d3ficiency anemia', 'Iron deficiency anemi4', 'Iron def!ciency anemia', reversed 'aimena ycneicifed norI', 'ɪron ...', 'Irօn ...' (Armenian o), 'anemiᎪ' (Cherokee), 'anemiɑ' (IPA a), 'anemiᴀ' (small cap) and 'Iron deficiency anem\u0345ia' -> all ALLOW (leak1.ts, leak2.ts). The guard drops the Latin I/l/1/| and O/0 classes that nameKey uses (LATIN_LOOKALIKES is applied only in toKey, not in compared()). Accents, Cyrillic/Greek homoglyphs, zero-width, spacing, hyphenation, case, fullwidth/math/circled forms, ligatures, tag characters, braille blank and bidi overrides are all REJECTED (held).
findings.expected: At least the digit/letter classes the project already folds for names (I l 1 | and O 0) and a reversed-label check.
findings.actual: Provider text with those variants is delivered.
findings.fix_hint: assistant.ts compared(): also apply names.ts LATIN_LOOKALIKES to both sides and test the reversed compared string; after fixing R14-A-01 the U+0345 case disappears.

findings.title: A provider text that is invisible or punctuation-only (zero-width space, U+3164, braille blank, variation selector, combining marks, '.') is delivered as the paid assistant hint instead of falling back to the faculty hint
findings.evidence: Game.cleanAssistantHint('\u200B', step) === '\u200B'; same for '\u2060\u200C', '\u3164', '\u2800', '\u0301\u0301', '\uFE0F', '.', '   \u200B   ' (-> '\u200B'). Only String.trim() decides emptiness, and trim() does not remove those. The code comment promises 'the learner always gets a real hint'. (U+061C is rejected as a bidi control; LRM/RLM allowed.)
findings.expected: Text with no visible letter or digit counts as empty -> source 'standard', faculty hint delivered.
findings.actual: source 'assistant', hint_log.text and hintsGiven hold an invisible string; -15 XP spent for nothing visible.
findings.fix_hint: game.ts cleanAssistantHint: return null when !hasVisibleCharacter(text) (http.ts) or when compared(text) is empty.

findings.title: /\b(the )?(correct )?(answer|option|choice) is\b/ rejects harmless hints, so the learner pays for the standard hint instead
findings.evidence: REJECT: 'Consider which option is most consistent with a low MCV.', 'The best choice is often guided by the indices.', 'The answer is not obvious; look at the MCV.', 'Your answer is based on the RDW and MCV.' (leak1.ts fp-option-is, fp-choice, fp-answer, fp-answer2). Label matching is also a plain substring of the squashed text ('kidneys' contains 'kidney'), by design. Names/numbers/units/prefix quotes/non-English hints (Thai, Chinese) are not falsely rejected.
findings.expected: Only statements that assert which option is right.
findings.actual: Quality loss of the AI hint, no penalty difference.
findings.fix_hint: assistant.ts: require a trailing option id or 'the label' after 'is', or accept this as the documented price of a last line of defence.

findings.title: Spacing is documented as ignored in teacher names, but for Greek words ending in ς the context-dependent final-sigma rule makes the key depend on the spacing: 'Νίκος Ζxx' and 'ΝίκοςΖxx' are two teachers
findings.evidence: foldCase = toLowerCase().toUpperCase().toLowerCase() lower-cases Σ to ς only when no letter follows (case-ignorables skipped), and spaces/hidden characters are removed AFTER that. Live on 5601: register 'Νίκος Ζhg' -> 201, then 'ΝίκοςΖhg' -> 201 (keys 'nikoςζ..' vs 'nikoσζ..'), while 'Li Wei X' / 'LiWeiX' is 409 as documented; 'Νίκος\u200BΖhg' and 'Νίκος\u3164Ζhg' are 409 against the second one. Characters that are Default_Ignorable but NOT case-ignorable (U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FFA0, U+2800) flip the sigma context too: nameKey('ΣΣ') vs nameKey('Σ\u3164Σ') differ (names2.ts).
findings.expected: ς and σ folded to one letter in the key (they are the same letter), so spacing never changes the key.
findings.actual: Two teachers whose names differ only by a missing space (Greek, word-final sigma).
findings.fix_hint: names.ts prepare(): after foldCase map 'ς' to 'σ' (nameKey/skeleton only; classNameKey too), keeping case folding first.

findings.title: The 10-character minimum is counted in code points before NFC, and whitespace-only passwords pass: ten spaces and ten decomposed 'é' (five characters once NFC-hashed) are accepted
findings.evidence: POST /api/auth/register password ' '.repeat(10) -> 201; 'e\u0301'.repeat(10) -> 201 (timing2.mjs). New hashes are NFC, so the stored secret is 5 characters long.
findings.expected: Minimum measured on the NFC string; blank passwords refused.
findings.actual: Weaker than the advertised 'At least 10 characters'.
findings.fix_hint: routes.ts register handler: reject when [...b.password.normalize('NFC')].length < 10 or !b.password.trim().

findings.title: Leaderboard abbreviation: names with no splitting space are shown in full to classmates (CJK, Thai, 'JeanDupont', 'Ann<ZWSP>Lee'), and a few odd initials survive ('™' -> 'T.', Hangul filler -> invisible initial 'Ann ㅤ.', 'ŉ' -> 'ʼ.', leading ZWSP word -> ' A.')
findings.evidence: Game.shortName('王小明') = '王小明', 'สมชายใจดี' unchanged, 'JeanDupont' unchanged, 'Ann\u200BLee' unchanged, 'Ann ™' = 'Ann T.', 'Ann \u3164' = 'Ann ㅤ.' (U+3164 is \p{L} so the 'letter-like' search accepts it), 'Zoë ŉ' = 'Zoë ʼ.' (short2.ts). 120 hostile names (emoji sequences, flags, RTL, combining-only, zero-width-only, 100 000-char words, surrogates, ß, dž, Turkish) produced no crash, no 5xx and no blank output.
findings.expected: Documented comment says 'Other students never see a full name'.
findings.actual: Single-token names are shown as typed; this is consistent with the code (parts.length < 2) but not with the comment.
findings.fix_hint: game.ts shortName: document the single-token case in KNOWN_LIMITATIONS, exclude Default_Ignorable letters (U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FFA0) from the initial search, and skip leading invisible-only words.

findings.title: HEAD on any GET route (including /api/health) answers 405 instead of mirroring GET without a body
findings.evidence: curl -I http://127.0.0.1:5601/api/health -> HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed, Allow: GET, OPTIONS. Load balancers and uptime probes that use HEAD report the API as down.
findings.expected: HEAD handled like GET (RFC 9110 section 9.3.2), no body.
findings.fix_hint: app.ts: treat HEAD as GET when matching routes and drop the body in send().

findings.title: OpenAPI text lags the round-13 behaviour: class-name rule says only 'case, spacing and invisible characters' (the key also folds compatibility forms and Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes), and no 429 declares the Retry-After response header or that CORS exposes it
findings.evidence: be/openapi.json POST /api/classes description vs names.ts classNameKey; 429 responses carry only the description string. The generated document is byte-identical to be/openapi.json and to GET /api/openapi.json (no drift).
findings.repro: cd be && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/openapi.ts > scratch/openapi.gen.json; cmp with be/openapi.json (identical); read the POST /api/classes description.
findings.expected: Rules and headers described where a client developer looks.
findings.fix_hint: routes.ts POST /api/classes description and http.ts openapi response builder (add headers: Retry-After on 429).

round13_fix_verification.1_names_key_case_fold_first: PARTIAL - key(upper)==key(lower) holds for every cased code point and in 1.2M contextual strings (also NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD stable, 0 failures, linear time up to 1M chars); broken only by U+0345 (R14-A-01) and by Greek final-sigma spacing (R14-A-07)
round13_fix_verification.2_assistant_answer_guard: PARTIAL - bidi, zero-width, spacing, hyphenation, case, accents, Cyrillic/Greek, fullwidth/math, reversed-under-override and 'the answer is' variants are caught; hint_log.text == delivered == hintsGiven, penalty -15 and source verified; gaps R14-A-03/04/05/06
round13_fix_verification.3_teacher_hash_n_suffix_rule: HOLDS - 90 variants tried (digits of every script, fullwidth/small/№ signs, I l | O look-alikes, brackets or not, hidden characters, accents, Cyrillic look-alikes); only forms that do not read as '(teacher #n)' pass ('t e a c h e r # 5', 'teach3r #5', 'ᴛeacher #5', 'teacher (#5)', 'teacher #(5)'); 'Mr Teacher #1 fan' and 'Schoolteacher #2' are refused, judged acceptable

round13_fix_verification.5_passwords_nfc: HOLDS - NFC register + NFD login 200, NFD register + both forms 200, NFKC variant 401, timing equal (existing 35.7 ms, nonexistent 33.9 ms, demo-flagged with demo off 34.6 ms, NFD two-scrypt 36.3 vs 35.8 vs 35.3 ms), 200-char and 400-code-point NFD handled, 1 MB / 70 KB bodies 413; only the minimum-length nit R14-A-08

notes: Environment: node v22.23.2; own servers 5601 (NODE_ENV=test+DEMO), 5602/5608 (real limits+DEMO), 5603 (real limits, no demo), 5604/5605 (three processes on ONE db with 5601), 5606 (CORS_ORIGIN pinned, login limit 3), 5607 (kill -9 target), 5611 (read-only db); all on throwaway DBs under scratchpad/r14-A, stopped by pid file at the end; be/data, be/openapi.json and every repo file untouched (find -newer marker shows nothing besides this report). Baseline: npm test 202/202 pass (TMPDIR in scratch), tsc --noEmit clean. HELD (could not break): (a) generic sweep: 465 cells route x token state (anon, student, demo student, teacher, other teacher, expired, forged secret, tampered signature, tampered payload sub, trailing segment, role lie, ghost user, string sub, empty bearer, alg-none) over all 29 operations: 0 undeclared statuses, 0 5xx, every bad/missing token 401; two fuzz runs (4 000 random methods/paths/headers/bodies, then 5 560 requests on valid templates with valid ids and hostile bodies incl. __proto__, unicode, 60 KB, 5000-deep nesting): 0 5xx, no stack in the log; raw sockets: 100 KB URL, bad percent-encoding, absolute-form, OPTIONS *, Content-Length mismatch, chunked, invalid UTF-8 body -> clean 4xx. (b) answer-leak scans: 6 players x all 10 missions (point, decision, stepper-choice, order, match, Master Lab) with random wrong answers and hints, 815 responses (start, GET, wrong, hint, GET-after-hint, right, result): 0 occurrences of an explanation/recheck/unpurchased hint/key property outside its own response; hintsGiven text equals the hint response each time; content endpoints as student 403; no order/match leak by display order; no standard hint or prompt contains its own label. (c) state machine: 20 parallel identical correct answers = 1x200 + 19x409 wrong_step (also 30 over 3 processes), 20/30 parallel wrong answers all counted (wrong_total 20/30, penalty capped correctly), 6/12 parallel hints = exactly the available 2, mixed answer+hint = one winner, post-completion answer/hint 409 attempt_finished, result 200, out-of-order and unknown stepId 409 wrong_step, IDOR on get/answer/hint/result 404, locked/unknown mission 403/404, restart creates a new attempt, malformed responses 400, expiry/backwards clock/limit boundary (in-process clock) correct. (d) scoring oracle: 60 missions with random wrong/hints, score == computeScore(own counts, server elapsed), ledger sum == score, accuracy formula; SQL invariants (inv.mjs: wrong/hints totals vs step_results, hint_log vs hints, score vs result_json vs ledger, best vs MAX(score), completions, xp_events == best, current_step vs solved, one active attempt per mission, exits need fragments) all 0 on a.db and after 4 kill -9 rounds of 40 parallel players (136 attempts left in progress, db:check problems: []). (e) analytics recompute from SQLite (studentsStarted/Completed, successPct, cleanFirstTryPct, avgHints per mission, roster xp) for a fresh 8-student class and the 38-student demo class: 0 differences. (f) limits without NODE_ENV=test: answers 120/min then 429 Retry-After 60 (a 429 does not count as a wrong answer), starts 60, profile writes 60, join 10/10min, register 100/h, login failures 60/IP/10min (spraying with parallel successes does not erode it: accounting is net-neutral), 3-hop XFF/X-Real-IP/Forwarded spoof ignored. (g) demo: demo-off 401 for minted demo tokens, login of seeded accounts refused, /auth/demo 404, reset 401/404; demo-on reset 403 for non-demo, teacher reset restores the name and classes, the reserved name cannot be taken while the demo teacher is renamed. (h) names: 30 parallel register variants over 3 processes = exactly 1 winner per round (3 rounds); 0 duplicate keys among 21 teachers; error shapes 400 validation_error with details / 409 name_taken; 10 000-char names 400 before any key work; all key/skeleton/classNameKey/suffix/leaks functions are linear (<=0.6 s at 1 M chars, 7 hostile patterns). (i) db:backup: verified copy 0600, refuses overwrite (exit 2), empty path exit 1, missing source exit 2. (j) migrations: v6 database with demo-domain lookalike accounts, 6 simultaneous starts: only accounts with the demo teacher's hash flagged. Not changed / judged acceptable: refusal of 'Mr Teacher #1 fan' and 'Schoolteacher #2' (no word boundary before 'teacher'); marks of non-Latin/Greek/Cyrillic/Arabic/Hebrew scripts change the name key (documented); Armenian/Cherokee/IPA confusables (documented residual).
